fusions.name: Unhurried Swell
fusions.desc: Rolls a slow swell of air outward, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaving each [Slowed] for 5 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Swirl
fusions.desc: Sends a slow swirl of air into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drifting Calm
fusions.desc: Restores 2 health a second to you and your allies for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sink and Surface
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
